purpose: Four-row structural form smoke of cell W1: that the legality table loads and verifies, that the card route narrows without error, that every request fits and that the episode completes. It is scored by no one and read by no one: four rows can never be evidence of benefit or of harm. The slot-contract card route (knowledge_stores.slot-contracts.candidate_supply.solver) gains candidate_legality_source, the pinned intent -> slot-type legality table prepared/SAEA-SLURP-INTENT-SLOT-LEGALITY-POOL-V1/legality.json: the route's authored index -- exactly the 402 (intent, slot type) pairs the released 9,354-utterance TRAIN exemplar store carries at least once -- is narrowed to the 286 pairs that store carries in at least two distinct utterances (rule pool-utterance-support-at-least-2-v1), so the Solver receives only the slot-contract cards for slot types legal under the row's shortlisted intents. The table can only remove an authored binding, never add one (enforced at load). Measured offline on the sealed AGREE arm: 12.90 -> 9.87 cards per row, 1,186 fewer prompt tokens per Solver contact on average (3,630 per row over the Solver, Reviewer and Planner contacts that render the block); 5 of 1,080 rows lose a card for a gold slot type (5 gold items, 1 of which the AGREE arm delivered exactly right). Nothing else moves: roster, geometry, session, program and its 11-contact ceiling, the three stores and their pins, the agreement term, the exemplar k of 20, the card route's caps, the role graph, every template, the deliver normaliser and the scorers are the retained AGREE arm's, byte for byte.
